lines.text: Did you know? Sens is Latin for feel.
Sensation: a feeling in the body.
Quick quiz! Which means not plus feel?

words.ex: I felt a burning sensation in my throat.
I don't have time for this nonsense.

publish.title: Sens root: sensation and nonsense
publish.value: Sens comes from Latin "sentire" (to feel). Words: sensation and nonsense. nonsense = non + sens.
